jobs.title: Product Launch Program Manager
jobs.description:
Tempur Sealy. Iconic brands. Storied history. Industry-leading innovation.

Tempur Sealy is committed to improving the sleep of more people, every night, all around the world. As a leading designer, manufacturer, distributor, and retailer of bedding products worldwide, we know how crucial a good night of sleep is to overall health and wellness. Utilizing over a century of knowledge and industry-leading innovation, we deliver award-winning products that provide breakthrough sleep solutions to consumers in over 100 countries. Our highly recognized brands include Tempur-Pedic®, Sealy® and Stearns & Foster®. We hire people who have a passion for helping others find their best night’s sleep. No matter what stage of your career, you can build your future at Tempur Sealy!

OUR COMPANY OFFERS GREAT BENEFITS, INCLUDING:
- Generous Paid Time Off
- Competitive Medical, Dental & other wellness programs
- Disability and Life Company Paid
- Retirement Plan Options
- Generous Employee Purchase Discounts

Pay Range: $81,000 - $117,000

Job Summary:  The Product Launch Program Manager has a pivotal role with End-to-End Supply Chain responsibility for the successful development, launch and End of Life management of TempurSealy (TSI) products. They are the Supply Chain ‘go-to’ for new product introduction for their program families. This position represents Supply Chain Planning and Sourcing as a Core Team member on New Product Launch (NPL) projects and other various supply chain projects as assigned.  Responsibilities are split between being an active member on multiple PMO-led cross-functional NPL Core Teams as well as leading other Supply Chain projects and initiatives.  Reporting requirements include tollgate reviews, supply chain readiness reviews, Product Transition Review, weekly status reviews. This position is critical for start-up coordination with respective Suppliers, TSI manufacturing facilities and internal stakeholders.

Extensive collaboration is required with various functions to ensure an optimal supply chain set-up. In addition, frequent communication will be necessary with the PMO, Sales, Marketing, Manufacturing, Development, Product Engineering, Logistics and Finance to ensure key stakeholders are kept informed.

A successful NPL Program Manager is a natural leader and facilitator; is dynamic, driven, organized and detail oriented; excels in program/ project management; communicates with ease at all levels; thrives in an ambiguous environment and is adept at facilitating actions and resolving conflicts.

What You’ll Do (Essential Duties and Responsibilities):
- Responsible for all supply chain planning activities associated to enable a flawless launch execution.
- Driving launch readiness in conjunction with marketing, engineering, operations, and sales teams.
- Communicating system requirements and schedules to facilitate technical readiness with cross-functional supply chain teams.
- Influencing product manufacturability, testability, and supply chain responsiveness in pursuit of high service levels and maximum flexibility.
- Providing recommendations to optimize the Supply Chain network especially with respect to total cost management, inventory management and business continuity.
- Leads the cross-functional planning team and manages the development, roll-out, and implementation of new product introduction into Operations.

- Proactively identifies opportunities for process improvement and cost reductions opportunities.
- Coordinating related efforts for Supplier and/or Component material qualification, ramp-up, and initial roll-out necessary to support Product launch timing.
- Resolve sourcing related problems for new programs i.e., pricing, scheduling, Supplier CapEx, lead-time, Logistics.
- Coordinate with Sourcing Category Managers (CM) for: - Selection of NPL-related component materials and associated Suppliers in alignment with Category Strategies.
- Support for RFQs/RFPs, related total cost analysis, and negotiated Terms and Conditions.
- Lead Supplier readiness reviews to ensure suppliers ability to meet Tempur Sealy’s requirements.
- Track and report on supplier performance during product launch period.

- Document complexity drivers of New/Unique/Difficult (NUDs).

- Create and lead reporting and presentations cross functionally each week.
- Consolidates and standardizes input for broader communication.
- Support other activities as assigned.

What You’ll Need (Qualifications):
- 5+ years of Supply Planning and/or Sourcing experience.  Previous experience in product launch management or product commercialization is a major plus.
- Demonstrated leadership capabilities, especially in building relationships and defining process within grey/nebulous areas.
- Strong ability in negotiating and influencing without authority in complex, high impact situations.
- Have excellent verbal/written communication, organization, and the ability to manage multiple projects/ timelines and effectively communicate and collaborate with various levels
- Have strong skills in project management, problem solving, process mapping.
- Maintain a high level of organization, commitment to follow through, enthusiasm and motivation.
- Strong strategic and analytical thinking, problem solving and rapid decision-making skills

Travel Required – 15% – 25%

Job Summary:

The Manager, Global Sourcing – North America Chemicals will lead activities for the development and execution of sourcing strategies for the NA Chemicals category and its execution across the North American business. They are accountable for the implementation of the strategy, value generation from cost savings initiatives, and continuity of supply. The Manager will be the direct interface to the supply base and be responsible for supplier management for all strategic and tactical issues.

The primary objective for this role is to be the marketplace expert for Tempur Sealy in North America on all aspects of commodity costs, performance and technology shifts and supply base trends, and to manage and lead the category activities related to product innovations, cost drivers, and market trends.

This position will report to the Director of Global Sourcing - NA Raw Materials and will support the Global Category Leader.

Continuity of Supply, Cost Management / Savings, KPIs, Category Risk Mitigation, Forecasting, Quality Improvements and New Product Launch models (80%):
Responsible to manage a broad range of materials and components as assigned by the Director of Strategic Sourcing. Primary focus of role are all Chemicals purchases related to polyurethane foam production at multiple sites in NA. Manage and lead the NA chemicals team consisting of a category specialist and a program manager
- Accountable for development and implementation of the NA Sourcing Strategy for the Chemicals Category, including alignment to the Global Sourcing Strategy as outlined by the Global Category Leader and overall company goals.
- Lead contract and pricing negotiations that provide favorable terms for, lead time, inventory levels, freight policies, payment terms, technology innovation, delivery, and disaster recovery planning.
- Manage a team of sourcing professionals. Allocate work according to project prioritization and team member bandwidth to maximize results.
- Own the supplier relationship with major suppliers on assigned categories.
- Responsible for managing the supplier balanced scorecard and conducting periodic reviews with supplier and TSI management.
- Accountable for owning and enforcing the terms and conditions of the supplier contracts.
- Implement, administer, and report the results of supplier initiatives covering assigned categories.
- Interface with senior level executives at suppliers and within TSI.
- Ensure operational compliance to global purchasing programs, addressing any issues that may surface.
- Manage assigned category specifications by structure, raw materials, and finishing applications.
- Obtain or secure material technology for exclusive Tempur Sealy use and competitive advantage.
- Develop total cost models and associated charts to analyze and understand base raw materials that comprise targeted components and raw materials within the spend assigned.
- Initiate alternative sourcing opportunities with new or current suppliers.
- Interact with Product Development, Marketing and Operations Management to develop and apply new materials and product improvements.
- Coordinate supplier certification process, approval, and compliance for the assigned material supply base in conjunction with the Supplier Quality Engineer.
- Negotiate contracts with assigned suppliers which achieve lowest system costs while maintaining the highest quality and service parameters.
- Create supply management strategies for assigned raw material categories, which improve plant inventory level days on hand, improve order accuracy and align lead time requirements.
- Establish strategies to reduce or eliminate excess and obsolete components or materials and consolidate raw material spend.
- Solicit and implement thoughts and ideas provided by plant sourcing, operations and manufacturing to better manage and optimize supply chain efficiencies.
- Work cross functionally with corporate Marketing, Advanced Technology, Product Development and Operations to develop best practices and earlier involvement with the introduction of new raw materials and product lines.
- Participate in cross functional events to express the best interest of all supply chain functions.
- Manage any supplier liaison or contract employees as assigned.
- Provide critical feedback loops to Manufacturing and Planning on appropriate supplier capacities for each facility depending on the complexity of the new products.
- Represent TSI at industry conferences and events, obtain and evaluate latest market intelligence

Administration (20%)
- Prepare RFI’s, RFQ’s, RFP’s, price analysis, maintains category chronological summary of supplier communications and required filing systems.
- Enter content information into electronic systems and updates/reviews data for accuracy.
- Coordinate contracting process with TSI Legal and ensure proper documentation, execution and management of contract extensions or amendments.
- Employ TSI favorable terms and conditions in all agreements.
- Resolve supply or quality related problems for assigned spends (i.e.: pricing, expediting, scheduling of orders, investigating discrepancies and gathering required and coordinating communications to internal business partners.
- Manage category specific data (part number, nomenclature, shipping footprint, unit of measure, lead time, etc.…).
- Maintain vendor master and category SKU’s/part numbers for accuracy.
- Disseminate information (i.e., pricing, SKUs, availability and packaging) to the plants and management as required.

Other primary duties and responsibilities include the following; however, Management reserves the right to assign or reassign other appropriate duties to this job at any time. This document excludes the marginal functions of the position that are incidental to the performance of fundamental job duties.

Working knowledge of the polyurethanes and / or petrochemicals NA market
- Knowledge of polyurethane foam processing and associated input material supply chains for Isocyanates and Polyols, and suppliers of these materials

- Ability to adapt and manage effectively in fast-paced and continuously changing environment
- Self-starter with experience in planning, assessing, and implementing change

- Cumulative experience of 10+ years Procurement, Engineering, or Supply Chain related fields

Job Summary:
The Category Sourcing Manager will play a key role in developing and executing global sourcing strategies that support Tempur Sealy’s business goals, product innovation, cost objectives, and supply continuity. This role will partner closely with Operations, Product Development, Marketing, Supplier Quality, Finance, and regional purchasing teams to manage assigned categories from strategy through execution.
The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong analytical skills, supplier relationship management experience, and the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced, evolving business environment.

What You’ll Do (Essential Duties and Responsibilities):

Develop and Execute Category Strategies
- Support the development and implementation of global category sourcing strategies using Tempur Sealy’s 6 Step Sourcing Process.
- Conduct industry, technology, innovation, cost driver, and competitive landscape analysis to identify sourcing opportunities.
- Analyze spend, total landed cost, supplier leverage, market dynamics, and multi-year category opportunities.
- Build strategies that improve cost, quality, service, innovation, and continuity of supply.
- Partner with regional purchasing teams to align local execution with global sourcing strategy.

Manage Supplier Relationships and Performance
- Own supplier relationships for assigned categories, from daily operational support to executive-level supplier engagement.
- Partner with internal stakeholders to support early supplier involvement in new materials, new product development, and product launches.
- Lead supplier performance reviews using balanced scorecards and cross-functional business reviews.
- Implement, maintain, and support compliance with supplier agreements, purchasing programs, and operational expectations.

Drive Cost, Risk, and Supply Chain Improvements
- Use RFx processes, competitive benchmarking, should-cost analysis, and total cost models to identify sourcing and value creation opportunities.
- Negotiate supplier agreements covering cost transparency, lead times, fulfillment strategies, payment terms, quality expectations, freight policies, technology collaboration, and disaster recovery planning.
- Identify and support alternative sourcing opportunities with new or existing suppliers.
- Develop and support risk assessments, mitigation plans, continuity of supply strategies, and disaster recovery planning.
- Resolve supply, quality, pricing, scheduling, expediting, and discrepancy issues in partnership with internal business teams and suppliers.

Support Product Development and Operational Execution
- Coordinate with New Product Development and Supplier Quality Engineering on new material specifications, supplier manufacturing processes, and supplier qualification activities.
- Provide feedback to Manufacturing and Planning teams regarding supplier capabilities, capacity, and facility-specific product complexity.
- Maintain accurate vendor master data and trade agreement information, including part numbers, pricing, nomenclature, shipping footprint, units of measure, lead times, and payment terms.
- Identify post-launch value engineering opportunities and support project teams as appropriate.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need (Qualifications):
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.
- 5+ years of experience in sourcing, procurement, engineering, operations, supply chain, or a related field.
- Strong analytical, math, business, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced and continuously changing environment.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project.
- Strong communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills.
